First, find the first derivative f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 to find critical points. Solve for x. To determine their nature, use the second derivative test: if f''(x) > 0, it’s a minimum; if f''(x) < 0, it’s a maximum. If f''(x) = 0, use other methods.
